## TableColumn.modalComponent property

The component to use for the modal. If a function is provided, it will be called with the cell context. The following properties are available on the cell context: - `row` - the row object - `column` - the column object - `table` - the table object

The function should return the name of the component to use for the modal.

Additionally, the following properties will be automatically passed to the modal component: - `colIndex` - the column index of the current cell - `rowIndex` - the row index of the current cell - `store` - the table data store

**Signature:**

```typescript
modalComponent?: string | ((context: CellContext) => string);
```
